name: White-lined Leafroller
desc: White-lined Leafroller (Amorbia humerosana): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 38 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Amorbia humerosana, the white-lined leafroller, is a species of moth of the family Tortricidae. It is found from the Gulf states to the northeastern United States and southeastern Canada.
